title: Two calls with a partner in one day: prep before, follow-up after

objects.subject: Two calls on 5 Oct
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Two calls on 5 Oct: product at 11 am and pricing at 4 pm IST. Could you share your API pricing sheet before the second one?

Aman Verma
Founder, Memloop

facts.claim: Aman Verma, founder of Memloop, asked for our API pricing sheet before the second of the two calls he set for the fifth of October.
Both calls were on the calendar for the fifth of October — product in the morning, pricing in the afternoon IST — and memory holds no words for either.
His ask for the pricing sheet is still listed open, waiting on us.
A card asking the founder to send Aman the API pricing sheet was surfaced to him.
The file has been quiet for about a day since the second call's time.
The engine reads the file both as account administration and as a sales opportunity.

inferences.claim: Whether the calls were held, and what they settled, is not on record: only the calendar shows them.
The pricing sheet is still owed on the record: the founder was told, the ask is open, and nothing from us is in the file.
The follow-up is still fresh: a day of quiet after the calls' time is not yet a lapse.
